title: GraphSmith evidence-retention entry (register Lane C)
description: One record in the append-only, hash-chained retention log: each assure packet chained to the prior packet's hash, anchored to the adoption-log head. Verifiable offline by a third party. Honest limit (A6): a privileged local attacker who rewrites both the store and the anchor is out of scope; remote/CI anchoring is the mitigation for shared/regulated use. Frozen Wave 0 (v0.3.0).

packet_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the assure packet this entry retains.

anchored_head.description: The adoption-log anchored chain head at retention time. MUST be populated (the v0.2.0 stub left this null); a real retention entry binds to a concrete head.

recorded_at.description: Timestamp. EVIDENCE ONLY (C1) — never a decision input. Optional.
